spans.s: चम् vt. 1P (pp. चांत; pres. चमति, but with आ, आचामति) 1. To drink, to drink off, to sip, चचाम मधु माध्वीकम् Bt.xiv.94; 2. to eat.With आ-, 1. to sip, to drink, यदीयानां वाचाममृतमयमाचामतिरसम् Bh.V.iv.38; 2. to dry up, to remove, आचामति स्वेदलवान्मुखे ते R.xiii.20, (स्वेदं) आचचाम सतुषारशीकारो भिन्नपल्लवपुटो वनानिलः ix.68.
चमत्करण n. 1. Admiration, surprise; 2. show, spectacle; 3. that which constitutes poetry, poetical charm (in rhetoric).
चमत्कार m. 1. Admiration, surprise; 2. show, spectacle; 3. that which constitutes poetry, poetical charm (in rhetoric).
चमत्कृति f. 1. Admiration, surprise; 2. show, spectacle; 3. that which constitutes poetry, poetical charm (in rhetoric).
चमर (I) m. A kind of deer.
चमर (II) m.n. A chowrie most usually made of the tail of chāmara.
चामर m.n. 1. A chowrie, the bushy tail of the Bos gnmniens used as a fly-flap and also as a badge of royalty, अदेयमासीत् त्रयमेव भूपतेः शशिप्रभं छन्नमुभे च चामरे R.iii.16, K.S.vii.42.
चामरा f. The same as चामर q.v.
चमर-पुच्छ (I) n. the tail of a chāmara used as a fan.
चमर-पुच्छ (II) m. a squirrel.
चमरिक m. The kovidāra tree.
चमरी f. The female chāmara, यस्यार्थयुक्तं गिरिजाजशब्दं कुर्वति बालव्यजनैश्चमर्यः K.S.i.13, 48, Megh.i.53, Sis.iv.60.
चामरा f. The same as चामर q.v.
चमस m.n. A vessel used at sacrifices for drinking the juice of Soma, M.v.116. (Also चमसी.)
चमू f. 1. An army in general, गजवती जवतीवहया चमूः R.x.10, वासवीनां चमूनाम् Megh.i.43; 2. a division of an army consisting of 729 elephants, as many cars, 2187 horse and 3645 foot.
चमू-चर m. a soldier, a warrior.
चमू-नाथ, -प, -पति m. the leader of an army, a general, R.xiii.74.
चमू-नाथ, -प, -पति m. the leader of an army, a general, R.xiii.74.
चमू-नाथ, -प, -पति m. the leader of an army, a general, R.xiii.74.
चमू-हर m. an epithet of Śiva.
चमूरु m. A kind of deer, चकासतं चारुचमूरुचर्मणा Sis.i.8.
चामर-ग्राह, -ग्राहिन् m. a person who carries a chāmara.
चामर-ग्राह, -ग्राहिन् m. a person who carries a chāmara.
चामर-ग्राहिणी f. a courtezan or waiting-girl who carries a chāmara, पृष्ठे लीलावलयरणितं चामरग्राहिणीनाम् Bhartr.iii.61.
चामर-पुष्प, -पुष्पक m. 1. the betel-nut tree; 2. the ketaka plant; 3. the mango tree.
चामर-पुष्प, -पुष्पक m. 1. the betel-nut tree; 2. the ketaka plant; 3. the mango tree.
चामरिन् m. A horse.
चामीकर n. 1. Gold, जगतीरिह स्फुरितचारुचामीकराः Sis.iv.24, K.S.vii.49; 2. the dhattūra plant.
चामीकर-प्रख्य a. like gold.
चामुंडा f. A terrific form of Durgā, M.M.v.
